brief.visual: Spare and luminous. Deep night-sea teal, warm parchment text and one sunrise-coral accent. Moon, star and boat as recurring motifs. Notebook pages, sketches, old maps, workshops, kitchens, roads and coastlines: the evidence of people engaging with life. Lots of negative space.
brief.motion: Slow, breathing camera moves with gentle parallax depth. Dust floating in the light, soft warm light leaks. Calm crossfades, slow zoom-outs and the occasional iris reveal. Never frantic: the pace of someone looking closely.
